definitions.explanation: The edible seed of the {銀杏|いちょう} (ginkgo) tree, eaten in autumn. Has a distinctive smell when fresh but a delicate, slightly bitter flavor when roasted, and is a classic ingredient in {茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}し and other Japanese dishes.

examples.english: In autumn, ginkgo nuts go on sale.

examples.japanese: {銀杏|ぎんなん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}し→茶碗蒸し：17312_chawanmushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}った→振る：01983_furu⟧⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧{銀杏|ぎんなん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: At the izakaya, I ordered roasted ginkgo nuts with salt.

notes:
The same kanji {銀杏|ぎんなん} is read both ぎんなん (the nut) and {銀杏|いちょう} (the tree). {銀杏|ぎんなん} is a treasured autumn ingredient, but the fallen fruits on city streets are notorious for their strong, unpleasant smell.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧{銀杏|ぎんなん}: roasted ginkgo nuts
- {銀杏|ぎんなん}⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧: rice cooked with ginkgo nuts
- {銀杏|ぎんなん}{拾|ひろ}い: gathering fallen ginkgo nuts

WATCH OUT:
Ginkgo nuts contain a toxin and should be eaten in small quantities (typically up to about 5–10 per adult per day); children should eat fewer.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {銀杏|いちょう}: ginkgo tree — same kanji, different reading; refers to the tree or its leaves
- ⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧: chestnut — another autumn seed, sweeter, less unusual flavor
